full_name: Kristen Schilt | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 Social Sciences Matina S. Horner Distinguished Visiting Professor The University of Chicago
bio: Kristen Schilt is an associate professor of sociology at the University of Chicago. A central focus of her work is finding new ways to make visible the taken-for-granted cultural assumptions about gender and sexuality that serve to naturalize and reproduce social inequality.
